findings.title: Interactive Remote Migration Authorization Gate
findings.description: Hosted database schema modifications required explicit human authorization before executing DDL against Supabase staging.
findings.remediation: Interactive approval requested via modal and explicitly granted. Pre-migration backup captured to scratch/staging-pre-migration-backup.json before running npx prisma migrate deploy on port 5432.

findings.title: Autonomous Sweep Overdue Attempt Collision with Late Answer Save
findings.description: In candidate test delivery, saveAttemptAnswer automatically finalizes an overdue attempt when a late write arrives, transitioning it to EVALUATED status immediately.
findings.remediation: Acceptance test verified both the automated late-write self-finalization path and the autonomous background sweep recovery for abandoned attempts (candidate disconnected).

findings.title: Staging Fixture Lifecycle & Cross-Run Idempotency
findings.description: Staging acceptance tests running against shared hosted databases must not pollute production tables or leave orphaned test attempts.
findings.remediation: Prefix all fixtures with unique run ID (stg_*), clean up foreign keys and users in test.after hook, ensuring pristine database state after every execution.

findings.title: Strict All-or-Nothing Scoring Enforcement on Hosted Staging
findings.description: Scoring engine must strictly award zero positive marks and deduct negative penalty for partial selections in MULTIPLE_CORRECT questions on the hosted database.
findings.remediation: Verified in STG-09: 4-question paper with partial response on Q2 yielded exactly 3 correct, 1 incorrect, raw score 5.500 / 8.000.
